description: New York museum founded in 1929 by three progressive patrons - Lillie P. Bliss, Mary Quinn Sullivan, and Abby Aldrich Rockefeller - who saw the need for an institution devoted exclusively to modern art. It has become arguably the most influential museum of modern and contemporary art in the world.
